interestingFact: Japan is known as the Land of the Rising Sun and has more than 6,800 islands.
Pakistan has one of the world’s largest irrigation systems and the second highest mountain, K2.
Switzerland is famous for its stunning Alps, chocolates, and being one of the most beautiful countries in the world.
Thailand is called the 'Land of Smiles' and is famous for its tropical beaches and street food.
New Zealand’s landscapes were used as the filming location for the Lord of the Rings movies.
The Maldives is the lowest-lying country in the world and famous for its overwater villas.
India is the world’s largest democracy and home to the Taj Mahal, one of the Seven Wonders of the World.
The USA is the world’s third largest country by land area and has the world’s largest economy.
Australia is home to the Great Barrier Reef, the world’s largest coral reef system.
Germany is famous for its engineering, Oktoberfest, and being the birthplace of the automobile.
